text_block_list.text: Waaah! Amazing, it's a huge haul~!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Still, are you sure it's okay for me to take all of this?

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thank you♪ With this much,
all my little sisters are gonna be so happy~!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I'll just keep one for myself.
